title: The Celebrities' Secret
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Inspector Megure, Takagi) omitted by convention; the deduction/confrontation scene and the sugar-rescue at the hospital are consequently represented only through the evidence/implicates edges and object/clue attrs they produce, not as edges sourced from a detective-cast node. case_type: attempted_murder (victim Kaoru Kusano survives both attacks). Old wiki-summary case file (cases/ep249-250_the_celebrities_secret.json) had the right culprit (Yuki Takeno) but was thin and missed the episode's real twist: the 'engagement party' was itself a fake, staged by the victim Kaoru Kusano and her fiance-of-convenience Kenzaki to make her manager Makuma jealous, with Terumi secretly helping Kaoru run the scheme rather than being estranged from her as the group's cover story claimed. The old file also completely omits Takeno's second attempted murder at the hospital (spiking the unconscious Kaoru with her father's diabetes medication to induce fatal hypoglycemia), the pre-existing/unresolved stalker subplot (bugged doll, threatening letters) that Takeno exploited as a frame-up rather than created herself, and it used only generic 'knows'/event-node edges instead of direct typed verb edges. murderer_id is unchanged from the old file (Yuki Takeno) -- the transcript confirms her as the true culprit.

clues.desc: The faint mark Yuki Takeno left on the engagement card looks like a lipstick kiss but is darker than lipstick alone would leave -- comparing it against Kaoru's blood shows it is in fact her blood, transferred to Yuki's lips when she bit off her own broken nail-blade right after the attack.

In Kaoru's ransacked bedroom, the drawers holding pens and scissors were rifled through while the drawers holding makeup and jewelry were left untouched -- inconsistent with a thief or an admiring fan looking for a keepsake, undercutting the theory that an outsider broke in to search the room.
